items.text: Security Papers Limited (hereinafter referred to as the “Company or SPL”) was duly incorporated as a Private Limited Company in 1965, and was subsequently listed on Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) in 1967, with a vision to be a recognized and accepted manufacturer of security featured papers providing the highest quality paper with numerous security features to its customers. The Company started its commercial production in 1969. The PM-2 plant was commissioned in 2003 and is capable of producing specialized security featured papers for Banknotes and Other Security Paper products with custom made security features including 3-dimensional tonal variation watermarks and numerous other counterfeit deterrence capabilities. Due to its strategic nature of operations, the Company has been classified as Category 1A (KPID) Key Point Installation by the Government of Pakistan. Principal Business
